name: Silver Arc
body:
School evocation [light]; Level adept 5, druid 5, shaman 5, witch 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target two creatures or objects which must be no more than 60 ft. apart
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create an arcing beam of moonlight between two targets. This moonlight deals 1d6 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) to both targets and any creatures in the line connecting them.

Additionally, all affected creatures are affected by the effects of moonlight if they have abilities or conditions triggered by moonlight. Any creature that has their DR assed by silver instead takes 1d8 per caster level (maximum 15d8) points of untyped damage. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage.
